_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by the model string each provider reports (Azure deployment name or Anthropic model id). The router computes cost_details from these and pushes them to Langfuse so cost populates even for custom deployment names Langfuse's own registry doesn't know. PLACEHOLDER RATES — verify against your provider contract and keep current. Models absent here get no router-computed cost (Langfuse's built-in registry still applies if it recognizes the model).
